scenario: First Blood in the Fallen City
summary: The Oathbound and the Wolves clash for the first time in the shadow of the Rock. An inconclusive brawl in the rain ends when a tenement collapses between the two forces.

warbands.name: Grimhammer's Oathbound
highlights: Held the field when the tenement came down and picked three shards of wyrdstone from the rubble.
lowlights: Durgin Alebelly was lost when the tenement collapsed — reaching for a barrel, as he lived.

members.name: Thorgrim Grimhammer
members.highlight: Traded blows with Yuri Wolfenstein in the rain and sent the bear-wrestler reeling with the flat of his hammer.
members.lowlight: Entered Durgin's death in the ledger — the first name owed to the vault that gold cannot repay.

members.name: Borri Forkbeard
members.highlight: Shot Yuri's best boot clean off his foot at thirty paces, ending the Ostlander charge in a heap of cursing.
members.lowlight: 'Grudge-Settler' misfired once in the rain, which Borri insists never happened.

members.name: Dagna Ironmaid
members.highlight: Stood in the doorway of the collapsing tenement, axes crossed, daring it to fall on her. It fell around her instead.
members.lowlight: Denied her doom again — the building missed.

members.name: Snorri Halfpint
members.highlight: Survived his first building collapse without a scratch, emerging from the dust holding someone else's helmet.
members.lowlight: Could not reach Durgin in the cellar before the roof came down.

members.name: Grimnir Coalfist
members.highlight: Held the left flank alone against two Ostlander kinsmen without a word or a step back.
members.lowlight: Took a club to the shoulder from Pavel that left his axe-arm stiff for a week.

members.name: Okri Stonebrow
members.highlight: Kept firing through the thunder of the collapsing tenement, entirely unbothered — he heard none of it.
members.lowlight: Never heard Durgin calling from the cellar.

members.name: Durgin Alebelly
members.highlight: Found the only cellar in Mordheim with the roof still on — an intact brewery stock, exactly as the rumours promised.
members.lowlight: Died as he lived — underground, in the dark, reaching for a barrel — when the tenement came down.

warbands.name: Wolfenstein's Wolves
highlights: Gave as good as they got in the brawl and withdrew in good order when the tenement fell.
lowlights: The tenement claimed two swords, a helmet, and Yuri's best boot.

members.name: Boris Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Read the groaning timbers before anyone else and pulled the clan back moments before the tenement fell.
members.lowlight: Declared victory over a pile of rubble, which convinced no one, including himself.

members.name: Yuri Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Went axe-to-hammer with Thorgrim Grimhammer himself and walked away to tell of it.
members.lowlight: Lost his best boot to the rubble and finished the battle hopping.

members.name: Anya Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Pinned the dwarf gun-line behind cover for half the battle with nothing but patience and a full quiver.
members.lowlight: The rain warped her spare bowstring, and three notches' worth of shots went wide.

members.name: Ludmilla the Crow-Mother
members.highlight: The crows shrieked a warning seconds before the tenement fell — the first of her three famous warnings.
members.lowlight: Spent the night setting Yuri's toes and listening to him describe the boot.

members.name: Pavel the Slow
members.highlight: Knocked the beardling Grimnir's axe-arm numb with one unhurried swing of his club.
members.lowlight: A falling beam bounced off his shield and flattened the clan cooking pot.

members.name: Mikhail Halfhand
members.highlight: Slipped through the dust cloud and lifted a purse of 5 crowns from the battlefield before the rubble settled.
members.lowlight: One of the two swords the tenement claimed was his.

members.name: Dmitri Wolfenstein
members.highlight: Dragged Mikhail clear of the falling masonry by his collar.
members.lowlight: The helmet the tenement claimed was the one he was wearing at the time. He was fine. The helmet was not.
